summary: KB Financial Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K updating its resolution to cancel 3,581,623 common treasury shares with an estimated book value of KRW 599,999,968,200 (~$465M at KRW 1,290/USD). The cancellation follows a board resolution originally disclosed April 23, 2026, with acquisition ending July 16, 2026 and scheduled cancellation on December 23, 2026. The legal basis is Article 343-1 of the Korean Commercial Code; cancellation reduces outstanding shares without reducing paid-in capital, effectively returning value to shareholders. Watch: any regulatory delays affecting the cancellation date, which remains subject to authority consultation.
